test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 3 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word given in the brackets to fill in the blank.

It will be _______________ (illogical) to accept the demands of the protesters this time
solution:
The correct answer is **Absurd.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Illogical** means not prudent, smart, or rational, typically because they are motivated by their emotions rather than critical consideration. 

 
 
• **Example**: *Her statements are totally illogical. *
 
 
 
• Absurd refers to things which are either foolish and unreasonable or amusingly silly.
 
 
• **Example:** *The answers that she gave in the test were totally absurd. *
 
 
 
• **"**Illogical**" **and** "**Absurd**"** are similar in meaning. 

Therefore, the correct option is Absurd**.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Unfavourable **refers to not offering you a competitive edge or a high likelihood of success.
 
• **Biased **refers to showing an excessive affinity for or aversion to a person depending on one's own preferences.
 
• **Factual **refers to utilising or containing facts.
